purpose: Find physically generated, mass-valid pond-depletion fixtures for the reverse PONDED_HEAD -> DRY_FLUX transition before freezing a qualification gate. Do not guess a depletion event or tune a qualification fixture after seeing candidate behavior.

starting_states.provenance: Exact reference final states from the qualified R2 workflow artifacts; these are positive-surface, mass-valid states generated by the forward dry-to-ponded event composition.

frozen_supply_scan.selection_rule: Among mass-valid depletion events with a mass-valid dry continuation, select the highest supply fraction. No additional fraction may be added after execution.
frozen_supply_scan.reason: Prefer a nontrivial continuing atmospheric supply where physics permits, rather than selecting zero supply merely because it is easiest.

reference_characterization_algorithm.soil_equations: Three conservative backward-Euler soil balances from the frozen positive-surface starting state to the event state, using the independent full-accuracy internal reference faces and the independent endpoint-aware 5 cm surface-face reference at h_surface=0.
reference_characterization_algorithm.physical_event_condition: qtop_event > q_supply beyond roundoff so the pond is depleting into the event and dry mode is admissible immediately after it.
reference_characterization_algorithm.dry_continuation: From the uncommitted S=0 event state, solve one reference dry-flux step with qtop=q_supply for dt_post=min(0.25*t_event,0.005 d for B01 or 0.001 d for O14). Require mass validity, negative top-node scope and dry complementarity at the continuation endpoint.

deterministic_fixture_selection.primary: highest supply fraction satisfying every event and dry-continuation acceptance condition
deterministic_fixture_selection.failure: If no frozen supply fraction yields a valid event plus dry continuation for a material, persist negative characterization and do not open R3 qualification for that material.

architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: Characterization state is never published; the future R3 gate must keep event state in trial scratch until the whole interval passes.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: Event time is a generic offset from each explicit starting t_day.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: Event and dry-continuation balances must each close without repair.
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: Only soil-step and surface-face reference contracts are used.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: Pond depletion and complementarity are physical; least_squares is characterization policy only.
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: Fixture search is reference-only and cannot be biased by candidate success.
architecture_checks.26_diagnostics_runtime: Selected forcing, event time, event state, balances and continuation admissibility must be explicit.

hard_nonclaims: No pond-depletion event localization algorithm is qualified here.
No candidate RossFast path is evaluated in this characterization.
No top soil-node h=0 or positive-head state is qualified.
No runoff, evaporation, snow, irrigation or macropore bypass is included.
No response tangent, production runtime, MultiSWAP, groundwater or MODFLOW admission follows.
